patthana16.9:1.1: Abyākataṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo nasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Abyākataṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naakusalo nasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Abyākataṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo nasappaṭigho ca naakusalo nasappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.9:2.1: Kusalaṃ appaṭighena tīṇi. Akusalaṃ appaṭighena tīṇi. Abyākataṃ appaṭighena tīṇi. Kusalaṃ appaṭighañca abyākataṃ appaṭighañca tīṇi. Akusalaṃ appaṭighañca abyākataṃ appaṭighañca tīṇi. Hetuyā pannarasa.
